purpose: Current terminology source. Historical records may retain superseded terms only when explicitly marked Historical.

scope.rule: Scopes are governed, mutable and instance-specific; no permanent universal list exists.

navigation.rule: Each interface has one official NAV. Local menus and page indexes are not additional NAV systems.

historical_only.retired_numbered_architecture: The former numbered LOC architecture is Historical only and forbidden in Current names, fields, navigation and responsibility identifiers.
historical_only.retired_multi_nav_terms: Former numbered navigation-layer names are Historical only.

migration_rule: Consumers must prefer current values in this registry. Do not rewrite historical evidence; explicitly mark it Historical or superseded.
display_rule: Public Current copy uses Current terminology and the owning Scope's governed labels.
